name: Earned Value Management
excerpt: Earned Value Management measures project performance based on scope, schedule, and cost.
notes: Earned Value Management is a key tool and technique for monitoring and controlling projects. It involves calculations such as Cost Variance (CV), Schedule Variance (SV), Cost Performance Index (CPI), and Schedule Performance Index (SPI) to assess financial effectiveness and schedule adherence.
context_summary: - Based on scope, schedule, and cost.
